basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer based in Austin, Texas. I have a strong passion for comic book movies and soccer, particularly the US Men's National Team. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late evenings. In my free time, I enjoy playing video games, especially classic titles like Escape Velocity Nova. I'm currently single and enjoy spending weekends watching movies or playing soccer with friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the field for the past six years. My interest in comic book movies comes from years of reading comics as a child and following their adaptations into films. My soccer knowledge is primarily self-taught, from watching games and participating in online forums.
